categories.name: PDF and Documents
categories.title: PDF and Document Tools Online | Prisma Space
categories.h1: PDF and Document Tools for Working with Your Files
categories.description: Merge, split, convert, sort, and prepare PDF and Word documents with online tools from Prisma Space. Check what each function does and its limitations.
categories.intro: When a document needs to be delivered, shared, or continued editing, format and order matter. This category brings together operations to organize pages, convert documents, and prepare files before sending them. You can open each tool from its card and review what it preserves and what it may change during the process.

highlights.title: Organize Pages
highlights.body: Combine files, separate ranges, extract pages, remove pages, and correct orientation without rebuilding the document from scratch.

highlights.title: Convert Documents
highlights.body: Convert between PDF, Word, HTML, and text formats when content and file type are compatible with the converter.

highlights.title: Review Before Sharing
highlights.body: Check metadata, number pages, or add a watermark when the document needs additional context.

faqs: Can I merge multiple PDFs into a single document?
Yes. The Merge PDF tool combines multiple files and preserves the order you set before downloading the result.
Does PDF to Word preserve the exact design?
No. Conversion prioritizes recovering editable text; complex columns, tables, and special fonts may need adjustments.
Do all PDF operations work the same?
No. Some are processed locally, while others are in beta or use a browser flow. Each tool's card explains its scope.

categories.name: Images
categories.title: Online Image Tools | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Online Tools for Compressing, Converting, and Preparing Images
categories.description: Compress, resize, crop, and convert images between JPG, PNG, and WebP. Explore Prisma Space's image tools and options.
categories.intro: An image may need less weight for a website, different dimensions for a publication, or a different format to maintain transparency or compatibility. Here, you can choose an operation based on the result you're looking for, review its options, and download a copy without confusing compression, cropping, and conversion.

highlights.title: Reduce File Size
highlights.body: Adjust compression to facilitate image sending or loading, comparing the result with the original.

highlights.title: Change Size and Format
highlights.body: Resize by dimensions, crop the frame, or convert between compatible formats like JPG, PNG, and WebP.

highlights.title: Prepare and Review
highlights.body: Add watermarks, create mosaics, check metadata, or remove EXIF information before sharing a photo.

faqs: Is compressing and resizing an image the same?
No. Compressing aims to reduce file size; resizing changes the number of pixels. You may need one or both operations.
Is WebP always better than JPG?
WebP may reduce weight in many cases, but the best option depends on compatibility, transparency, and required quality.
Can I remove a photo's location?
The metadata tool allows you to clear EXIF information from the image. Review the final file before sharing it.

categories.name: AI and Creation
categories.title: Artificial Intelligence and Creation Tools | Prisma Space
categories.h1: AI Tools for Creating and Working
categories.description: Explore text assistants, image generation, prompt improvement, voice, and creative support in Prisma Space. Check requirements and availability.
categories.intro: Prisma's AI features cover different tasks: writing, reviewing, planning, improving instructions, creating images, or working with voice. Not all use the same provider or have the same conditions. Some are in beta, require an external connection, or a personal key; review those requirements before starting a task.

highlights.title: Writing and Review
highlights.body: Organize ideas, prepare drafts, and request a critical review. Always verify data, citations, and statements before publishing.

highlights.title: Image and Creativity
highlights.body: Explore visual generation and idea composition using available motors and their usage limits.

highlights.title: Voice and Content
highlights.body: Try text-to-speech, transcription, and content support. Availability depends on the connected provider and its rates.

faqs: Are all AI tools free and unlimited?
No. Some functions are in beta, may require a personal key, or depend on credits and provider limits.
Does Prisma guarantee that an AI response is correct?
No. AI can be incorrect or invent data. Verify important information and do not use an unreviewed output as professional advice.
Can I generate images and audio from Prisma?
There are creative functions for image and voice, but each has its own requirements and availability, shown in its tool.

categories.name: Audio and Video
categories.title: Online Audio and Video Tools | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Tools for Editing and Converting Audio and Video
categories.description: Trim, convert, normalize, and prepare audio and video files from Prisma Space. Check compatibility, beta status, and limitations for each operation.
categories.primaryQuery: tools for editing audio and video online
categories.intro: Multimedia files are often large and their formats may not be compatible with all editors. This collection brings together point operations to trim clips, change resolution, extract audio, convert formats, and inspect a waveform. Several functions are in beta and depend on device and browser memory.

highlights.title: Trim Clips
highlights.body: Trim audio or video by specifying the segment you need, without having to open a multi-track editor for a simple task.

highlights.title: Convert and Adjust
highlights.body: Change audio formats, normalize volume, or modify video resolution and speed when the engine supports the file.

highlights.title: Extract and Prepare
highlights.body: Capture a frame, generate a GIF, or separate audio from a video to reuse it in another workflow.

faqs: Can I process any video size?
There is no universal compatibility. Large files may require more memory and time; try first with a small clip.
Are multimedia functions in production-ready status?
Several operations are in beta status. Check the status of each tool and verify the result before using it.
Does Prisma replace a professional editor?
No. These tools resolve specific operations; they do not offer multi-track editing or a complete professional workflow.

categories.name: Text and Writing
categories.title: Online Text Tools | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Text Tools for Cleaning, Transforming, and Organizing Content
categories.description: Counts words, cleans text, changes case, extracts data, and converts text formats with Prisma Space utilities.
categories.intro: Small text tasks pile up: cleaning spaces, normalizing characters, ordering lines, extracting emails or links, converting text, and preparing data for another application. These tools are designed to resolve a specific operation and allow you to review the result before copying or downloading it.

highlights.title: Clean and Normalize
highlights.body: Removes blank lines, repeated spaces, diacritics, or duplicates and applies case changes as needed.

highlights.title: Extract Information
highlights.body: Identifies emails, links, phone numbers, or hashtags within a block of text and preserves the result in a list.

highlights.title: Convert Structures
highlights.body: Encodes Base64 or URL, works with HTML and Markdown, and transforms CSV and JSON in the supported directions.

faqs: Is the text sent to a server?
Local utilities run in the browser. In any connected operation, consult the description and conditions of that tool.
Can I process long texts?
It depends on the browser's memory and the operation. For extensive documents, divide the content and check the result.
Do the tools change the original text?
They work on an input and generate an output; keep a copy of the original if you need to compare or revert changes.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.title: Free online utilities: QR and calculators | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Online utilities for calculations, conversions, and QR codes
categories.description: Use calculators, unit and date converters, QR code generators, barcode codes, and other quick utilities from Prisma Space.
categories.intro: Not all tasks require a complex editor. Sometimes you just need to convert a unit, calculate a percentage, compare dates, create a QR code, or check a color combination. This category groups direct utilities to resolve those operations from the browser.

highlights.title: Calculate and convert
highlights.body: Solve percentages, expressions, date differences, time zones, currencies, and units with explicit inputs.

highlights.title: Create codes
highlights.body: Generate QR codes and barcode codes from the data you want to represent and check the result before printing it.

highlights.title: Check details
highlights.body: Verify color contrast, palettes, and other practical values for design and daily work.

faqs: Does the currency converter use real-time exchange rates?
Check the date and source shown by the tool. Reference exchange rates may be delayed and do not equate to a bank quote.
Can QR codes be used commercially?
You can download the result, but verify that the encoded content is correct and the destination is still available.
Do calculators replace professional reviews?
No. For financial, tax, medical, or legal decisions, verify the results with suitable sources and professionals.

categories.name: Web Development and Programming
categories.title: Online Programming Tools | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Web Development Tools, Code, and APIs
categories.description: Format code, validate structures, test regular expressions, decode JWT, and explore APIs with developer utilities.
categories.intro: During development, it's common to need to inspect a response, clean a structure, test a regular expression, or review a token. Prisma brings together point-specific utilities for these tasks, without aiming to replace an IDE, a debugger, or a security audit.

highlights.title: Format and Validate
highlights.body: Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, XML, JSON, and schemas when the corresponding tool supports the structure.

highlights.title: Inspect and Test
highlights.body: Decode the readable part of a JWT, test regex patterns, and generate hashes to compare files.

highlights.title: Explore Resources
highlights.body: Query public APIs and discover open-source projects. Review permissions, limits, and documentation before integrating a service.

faqs: Does decoding a JWT verify its signature?
No, necessarily. Decoding allows you to inspect the readable content; it doesn't demonstrate that the token is authentic or valid.
Can I send private keys to the tools?
No. Don't paste passwords, active tokens, private keys, or secrets in public tools.
Do the utilities replace project testing?
No, they're point-specific supports. Validate code in your environment, with your dependencies, and automated tests.

categories.name: Data and Spreadsheets
categories.title: Tools for CSV, JSON, and Excel | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Tools for Reviewing and Converting CSV, JSON, and Excel Data
categories.description: Inspect CSV files, query statistics, and convert data between CSV, JSON, and Excel with Prisma Space's tools.
categories.intro: Before importing data into an application or sharing a spreadsheet, it's a good idea to review headers, empty rows, value types, and structure. This category gathers operations for profiling CSV, querying statistics, and converting compatible formats, with notes on beta functions.

highlights.title: Inspect CSV
highlights.body: Review structure, headers, and basic metrics to detect issues before proceeding with analysis.

highlights.title: Convert Formats
highlights.body: Transform CSV to JSON, JSON to CSV, and use Excel converters available to exchange data between tools.

highlights.title: Validate Structures
highlights.body: Check schemas and compare JSON objects when you need to detect differences between versions.

faqs: Do all Excel types and formats get preserved?
No, always. Conversions depend on the format and tool; check sheets, formulas, and data types after exporting.
What should I review before converting CSV?
Confirm the delimiter, headers, encoding, and whether fields contain commas or line breaks.
Can I use the output as a definitive database?
No, without validation. Review duplicates, required fields, formats, and values before importing data into production.

categories.name: Privacy and Files
categories.title: File Privacy and Metadata | Prisma Space
categories.description: Inspect files, query metadata, and remove EXIF data or sensitive information before sharing documents and images.
categories.intro: A file can contain more information than what appears at first glance: EXIF data, document properties, internal names, or sensitive text fragments. These tools help inspect and clean compatible metadata, but do not replace a thorough review of the content before sharing it.

highlights.title: Inspect Files
highlights.body: Check the file type and visible properties to understand what you're about to share.

highlights.title: Review Metadata
highlights.body: Verify image EXIF data and PDF document properties before distributing them.

highlights.title: Clean Information
highlights.body: Remove compatible metadata from images or PDFs and conceal sensitive data in text blocks, always reviewing the output.

faqs: Does removing metadata delete visible content?
No. Cleaning metadata does not automatically censor text, faces, license plates, or information appearing within the image.
Does cleaning guarantee anonymity?
No. Identifiable information may remain in the content, file name, history, or context. Review everything before publishing.
What should I do with confidential documents?
Avoid uploading them to external services without authorization. Use local processing when available and follow your organization's policies.

categories.name: Study and Research
categories.title: Tools for studying, citing, and researching | Prisma Space
categories.h1: Tools for studying, organizing references, and researching
categories.description: Generate bibliographic references, extract academic identifiers, and prepare study materials with Prisma Space tools.
categories.intro: Studying and researching involves more than summarizing a text: you also need to organize sources, identify publications, and maintain consistency in references. Prisma offers utilities for generating citations, extracting identifiers, and exploring AI support in beta, always reviewing the original source.

highlights.title: Citing Sources
highlights.body: Prepare references in available bibliographic styles and manually review authors, titles, dates, DOI, and editorial data.

highlights.title: Identifying Publications
highlights.body: Extract DOI, PMID, and arXiv from texts to locate articles and complete a bibliographic review.

highlights.title: Organizing Study
highlights.body: Explore support functions for study guides, checking their beta status and reviewing the generated content.

faqs: Are the generated references ready to submit?
Use them as a draft. Verify each bibliographic data in the original publication and adapt the format to your institution's instructions.
Does Prisma guarantee an article exists?
No. The extraction of identifiers helps locate references, but you must check that the DOI, PMID, or arXiv corresponds to the source.
Can AI do my academic work for me?
It can support organization and explanation, but you must understand, contrast, and write your own work following academic rules.
